technology_name: Reviving Native Ecosystems: A Sustainable Restoration Initiative
problem_solved: Soil degradation, severe groundwater depletion, loss of biodiversity, and diminished carbon sequestration capacities caused by historic, exotic monoculture plantations (e.g., Acacia, Eucalyptus).
description: A comprehensive, site-specific eco-restoration methodology developed to convert ecologically damaging exotic monoculture plantations back into high-functioning native ecosystems. The framework utilizes field-level ecological data assessments to design a phased, structured removal of invasive exotic species, paired with the strategic reintroduction of native vegetation that balances biodiversity recovery with local socio-economic value.
applications:
• Forest department frameworks for converting commercial state timber plantations

• Watershed management and groundwater replenishment programs in forest fringe zones

• Large-scale corporate ESG carbon offset and biodiversity restoration initiatives

• Environmental impact mitigation and green-belt planning for public land-use agencies
